name: @wocwang/cortico-world-rvc-for-coopanion
description: Cortico World for Coopanion: voice conversion with RVC — upload any audio and get it back in the pet's voice, plus a local HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9881) for other plugins
author: wocwang

zh.description: 把任意一段音频换成桌宠的音色：上传音频、可选变调、试听与落盘，全程在本机推理。和 gpt-sovits（说话）、DiffSinger 唱歌是同一套本机声音链路，三个插件可以配合使用——既能给 QQ 语音「出口变声」，也能把唱出来的干声换成这里的音色。占用约 1 GB 显存、2.5 GB 内存（显卡档实测）。内置示例音色「星落落大肥鱼」（仅供个人非商业使用，注明音源即可），也支持导入自备 .pth / .index。另开一个只监听本机的 HTTP 接口（默认 127.0.0.1:9881），其他插件可以用 POST /convert 直接拿到变声后的音频。只做推理，不做训练。

en.description: Turns any audio clip into the pet's voice: upload, optional pitch shift, preview and save, all inferred on your own machine. It is part of the same local voice chain as gpt-sovits (speech) and DiffSinger singing, and the three plugins can run together — this one can post-process the voice sent to QQ, or convert the dry vocal that the singing plugin produces. About 1 GB VRAM and 2.5 GB RAM on the GPU tier (measured). Ships the built-in "Xingluoluo DaFeiyu" voice (personal non-commercial use only; credit the source) and accepts your own .pth / .index. Also serves a loopback-only HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9881 by default) so other plugins can POST /convert and get the converted audio back. Inference only, no training.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
